scope: Existence of the extension at c=-3/32 on every finite simple graph, agreeing with every chord diagram; no bound on graph size.

formal_definitions_audited.weight_system: Explicit finite-dimensional E,F,H matrices, Casimir tensor, matrix word and normalized trace. It is not defined using ξ.
formal_definitions_audited.graph_invariant: Explicit finite signed count of two-element subsets using every colour.
formal_definitions_audited.graph_relation: Edge toggle and neighbourhood symmetric difference at distinct vertices.
formal_definitions_audited.quantifiers: Every natural n, chord diagram D and finite graph; no finite search cutoff or unproved hypothesis.

written_obligations.argument: Group assignments by their used colour set. T_k=0 above 2n. Evaluate the resulting finite polynomial at -2.
The symmetric-difference involution on labels meeting in one colour pairs the two signed differences for every graph.
Centrality on the universal Verma module, reflection μ↦-2-μ, and infinitely many finite-dimensional quotients give unique w_D.
Every 2n-letter Verma coefficient has degree at most 2n; reflection halves this to deg w_D≤n. This justifies exact n+1-point interpolation.
Falling factorials of distinct degree make Weyl normal forms linearly independent; the two oscillator summands give the same scalar.
Twisted cyclicity gives Wick recursion. The parity identity on alternating matching cycles supplies each factor -2.
Anticommutator Wick expansion gives the matching polynomial; antisymmetrized paired legs yield 4^n S_G(N) for all positive N, hence polynomially at -2.
(-1/32)^n times 4^(-n) times 4^n S_G(-2) equals ξ(G), including the empty diagram.
